scenario.title: 在會議上表達同意與不同意
scenario.context: 英文會議最難的不是聽懂，而是敢開口，尤其是要說「我不同意」的時候。這個單元學怎麼同意、部分同意、禮貌地反對，也修正台灣人最經典的錯誤：I'm agree。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: So the client wants the logo in bright red. Thoughts?
lines.zh: 客戶希望 logo 用亮紅色。大家覺得呢？

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: I agree. Red fits a spicy noodle brand.
lines.zh: 我同意，紅色很適合辣味麵品牌。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree. Every noodle brand on the shelf is already red.
lines.zh: 我懂你的意思，但我不太確定。貨架上每個麵品牌都已經是紅色了。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Good point. So what would you suggest?
lines.zh: 說得好。那你會建議什麼？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Maybe a deep orange? It still feels spicy, but it'll stand out.
lines.zh: 也許用深橘色？還是有辣的感覺，但會比較突出。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hmm, I partly agree. It's a risk, though. The client was pretty clear.
lines.zh: 嗯，我部分同意。不過有風險，客戶講得蠻明確的。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Let's make sure we're on the same page before we talk to them. Can we do one red and one orange option?
lines.zh: 跟客戶談之前我們先確認想法一致。可以做一個紅色、一個橘色的方案嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Should we also discuss the packaging timeline?
lines.zh: 我們要不要也討論一下包裝時程？

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Let's put a pin in that. We're almost out of time.
lines.zh: 那個先放著，我們快沒時間了。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sure. Can we circle back to it on Thursday?

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Definitely. Minz, could you touch base with the printer before then?
lines.zh: 一定。Minz，在那之前你可以先跟印刷廠聯絡一下嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Will do. I'll email them this afternoon.
lines.zh: 好的，我今天下午寄信給他們。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Great. Anything else before we wrap up?
lines.zh: 很好。結束前還有別的嗎？

patterns.note: 先認同再轉折，反對聽起來溫和很多

patterns.en: Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by ___?
patterns.zh: 抱歉，可以說明一下 ___ 是什麼意思嗎？

patterns.en: Anything else before we wrap up?

chinglish.why: agree 是動詞，不是形容詞，前面不加 am。中文「我同意」沒有 be 動詞的概念，但很多人受 I'm sure / I'm right 影響而加了 am。
否定也是一樣，agree 是動詞，用 don't。

chinglish.right: I'm not sure that'll work, because ___.
chinglish.why: 英文職場很少直接說別人錯，會用 hedging 軟化並附上理由。直說 wrong 聽起來很有攻擊性。

chinglish.wrong: I have a question want to ask.
chinglish.right: I have a question. / Can I ask a question?
chinglish.why: 中文「我有問題想問」直翻會多出一個動詞。

grammar.title: 同意／不同意：I agree（不說 I'm agree）
grammar.oneLiner: agree 是動詞：I agree / I don't agree；搭配 with 人、on 議題、that 子句。
whenToUse: agree with + 人或意見：I agree with you / with that.
agree on + 議題（達成共識）：We agreed on the budget.
agree to + 提議（答應）：The client agreed to our timeline.
agree that + 子句：I agree that red is too common.
否定：I don't agree / I disagree。disagree 比較直接，前面常加 I'm afraid I… 或 I have to respectfully…
程度：I totally agree / I partly agree / I couldn't agree more.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「我同意」「我很確定」「我準備好了」看起來結構一樣，但英文分別是動詞 agree、形容詞 sure、形容詞 ready。台灣人以為「同意」是一種狀態，就在前面加 am。另外，中文開會文化裡直接反對比較少，所以台灣人要嘛不說，要嘛一開口就太直接。

examples.correct: I don't agree with that approach.
examples.incorrect: I'm not agree with that approach.

examples.correct: We finally agreed on a color.
They agreed to extend the deadline.
examples.note: 答應某個提議用 agree to。

examples.correct: I agree that the timeline is tight, but it's doable.

quiz.question: I ___ agree with that. I think it's too risky. (否定)
After two hours, we finally agreed ___ a name.
The client agreed ___ our new budget.
quiz.explanation: 答應某個提議用 agree to。

quiz.question: Which is the most polite way to disagree?
options: I see your point, but I'm not sure that'll work.
quiz.explanation: 先認同，再委婉表達疑慮。

slang.usage: 確認大家對某事理解相同。Let's make sure we're on the same page.

examples.en: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
examples.zh: 開始之前，先確認大家想法一致。

examples.en: I don't think the client and we are on the same page.
examples.zh: 我覺得我們和客戶的認知不一樣。

slang.meaning: 簡短聯絡一下、確認一下
slang.usage: touch base with someone，簡單溝通或更新進度。

risk.note: 典型的職場用語，有人覺得有點老套，但非常普遍。

examples.en: Let's touch base next week about the launch.
examples.zh: 下週我們再針對上市聯絡一下。

examples.en: I'll touch base with the printer tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天跟印刷廠確認一下。

slang.usage: circle back to something / circle back on something，稍後再處理某話題。

risk.note: 被認為是很重的職場行話，常被取笑，有時也被當成「拖延」的委婉說法。用可以，別每句都用。

examples.en: Good question. Can we circle back to that after lunch?
examples.zh: 好問題，我們午餐後再回來討論好嗎？

examples.en: I'll circle back once I hear from the client.
examples.zh: 等客戶回覆後我再跟你更新。

slang.usage: 像把便條釘在牆上，之後再回來處理。

risk.note: 會議上很常用，語氣輕鬆。

examples.en: Let's put a pin in the budget discussion for now.
Interesting idea. Can we put a pin in it?
examples.zh: 有意思的想法，可以先記下來之後再談嗎？

review.question: I ___ in this company since 2022.
review.explanation: 複習第 21 單元：since + 起點，用現在完成式。

review.question: Karen ___ me the meeting was moved to 3.
review.explanation: 複習第 20 單元：tell + 人。

review.question: The final files will be ___ (send) to the client tomorrow.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：被動 will be + p.p.。

review.question: We don't have ___ time left. Let's wrap up.
review.explanation: 複習第 6 單元：time 不可數，用 much。

review.question: Let's make sure we're on the same ___ before the client meeting.
review.explanation: on the same page = 想法一致。
